name: HOME_ALL
description: Homes all axes with a safe sequence

name: PARK
description: Parks the print head at a safe position
gcode:
[gcode_macro PARK]
gcode:
    {% set X = params.X|default(10)|float %}
    {% set Y = params.Y|default(10)|float %}
    {% set Z = params.Z|default(25)|float %}
    SAVE_GCODE_STATE NAME=PARK_state
    G91
    G1 Z{Z} F600
    G90
    G1 X{X} Y{Y} F6000
    RESTORE_GCODE_STATE NAME=PARK_state

name: CENTER
description: Moves the print head to the center of the bed
gcode:
[gcode_macro CENTER]
gcode:
    G90
    G1 X{printer.toolhead.axis_maximum.x / 2} Y{printer.toolhead.axis_maximum.y / 2} Z25 F6000
